integrity: The included proof explicitly establishes the group law, coefficient criterion, necessary and sufficient coloring condition, and complete image-size sum. Seven finite configurations were exhaustively checked using actual quotient-algebra multiplication; independent external mathematical review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers units of radical-square-zero finite quiver algebras; it gives word images and minimal commutator lengths, not representation-fiber multiplicities. Its scientific originality has been compared only against the identified literature; an equivalent result in semidirect-product language could exist. Finite checks supplement, rather than replace, the proof.
source_ids: published-research-record:Commutator fibers and commuting probabilities of finite Kronecker path algebras
title: Chromatic thresholds for commutator products in finite quiver-algebra unit groups
